translations.关闭：沿连续模型表面贴合。\n开启：跨过限定宽度的小缝或边缘轻微穿插，沿外露表面:
Off: follow continuous model surfaces.
On: cross narrow gaps or slight edge intersections along exposed surfaces.
For sharp corners, also enable Follow sharp edges. This does not fill geometry or cross attachment instances.
translations.允许跨越的最大缝宽：0.1–20 mm，默认2 mm。\n沿边拖动或Ctrl+单:
Maximum gap width: 0.1–20 mm; default 2 mm.
Drag, or Ctrl-click to type. Large gaps, distinct steps and ambiguous connections still stop the decal.
translations.开启后允许沿135°以内的折角继续贴合，例如机背直角与机翼外唇。\n关闭恢复65:
Allows bends up to 135 degrees, such as spine corners and wing lips.
Turning off restores 65 degrees. Fine-tune below. Facing and occlusion checks still apply.
translations.[ / ] 调整大小，Q / E 旋转；右键旋转模型，滚轮缩放视角。: [ / ] Resize, Q / E Rotate. Right-drag to orbit; scroll to zoom.
translations.遇到更陡的折角停止延伸；数值较小可避免越过尖锐边缘。: Stop at steeper bends. Lower values avoid crossing sharp edges.
translations.限制落点前后的投射厚度；弯曲表面漏印时可适当增加。: Limits projection thickness around the anchor. Increase if curved surfaces have missing areas.
translations.遮挡按放置时的视角判断；旋转观察不会改变已放置的贴花。: Occlusion uses the view at placement time. Orbiting afterward does not change the placed decal.

Earlier low-resolution stamps cannot regain detail by changing this option. Repaint from the original livery.
translations.当前画布尺寸保持不变；更高上限仅用于新画布。: Existing canvas size is retained. Higher limits apply only to new canvases.
translations.按落点附近的 UV 密度估算。曲面上各处可能不同；小贴花只占贴图的一小部分。\n:
Estimated from UV density near the anchor; density may vary over curved surfaces. Small decals occupy only a fraction of the texture.
The floating preview samples the source image directly; stamped detail is limited by destination texture pixels.
